proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 1977 article gives Malayalam cevi ear, the outer ear; cevikka to hear; ceviṭu, cekiṭu ear, chiefly the inner part; cevi-ppī, ceppi earwax; ceviyan hare; ceppi ear; koviṭu, (Tiyya) ceviṭu cheek. Ālku. kevi ear.. The Malayalam survey form cevi “ear” is proposed within this article family.

proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 4666 article gives Malayalam maṇ, maṇṇu earth (as one of the five elements), soil, mud, mudwall, wall, earth as opposed to heaven.. The Malayalam survey form maṇṇɯ “earth (soil)” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
